snippet.description:
No babies were harmed during the making of this video. $1,000 GIVEAWAY! How to enter: sign up to Whatnot using my link https://www.whatnot.com/invite/caddicarus and follow me on Whatnot. Winner will be picked in a month. #whatnotpartner Also - get $15 off your first purchase on Whatnot using this link 👉 https://www.whatnot.com/invite/caddicarus

Written, performed and edited by Jim Caddick.

WITH ONGOING THANKS TO......
- Olly Ross for filming (https://www.youtube.com/@OllyRoss)......
- Tee Lopes for the intro theme song arrangement (https://www.teelopesmusic.com)......
- Crisppyboat for the intro video and logo branding (https://www.crisppyboat.ca)......
- JetPackBraggin for all of my thumbnails (https://bsky.app/profile/jetpackbraggin.bsky.social)......
- Cerys Mackay for her costume/makeup/prop/secondary-pair-of-hands assistance......
- Channel Dog for Photoshop assistance [the snowy mountains with no people, Veruca Salad and Athlete's Food, 384 frogs and 32 buckets] (https://www.youtube.com/@ChannelDogYT)......


SPECIAL THANKS FOR THIS VIDEO SPECIFICALLY TO......
- Sam and Alice for their cameos and assistance during the 'Keyring Key Keyring' segment and 'I Live in the Bin' song segment......
- Chris Johnson for his voice cameo as 'The Boo-t' (https://bsky.app/profile/officialcdj.bsky.social)......


All stock images provided by Shutterstock and all stock sounds and music provided by Epidemic Sound. 'Nick on Sunset' footage found here: https://youtu.be/TB_wCqreisk?si=Ph2lOQjwHYzzsJ2n 


Oh no it's Rugrats. By Nickelodeon. Ever since Rugrats Search for Reptar PS1 and Caddy having his Rugrats Search for Reptar review from all those years ago, Caddicarus has wanted to talk about all of the Rugrats games available from Nickelodeon and their own Nickelodeon games, or as some would call them, Nick games, but I don't know who Nick is. The first Nickelodeon game that Caddicarus made a video about all those years ago during the retro reviews era was actually Rugrats Totally Angelica PS1, better known as Rugrats Totally Fanny as per the original title of the Totally Angelica review. Caddy no longer does game reviews and stopped doing the basic ideas of his regular review show many years ago, in fact he hasn't done a game review in over 5 years now, let alone a game review of a Rugrats review. But now, in his current style, Jim will look at as many Rugrats PS1 games he can stomach while making as many jokes and out of context moments as possible, all the while never answering the question if one Rugrats game or another is actually good or bad, because who cares. Chuckie definitely doesn't, nor does Chuckie Rugrats. Tommy Pickles also doesn't care, because he's Tommy Pickles Rugrats starring in his own bad PS1 games. But didn't I just say that Jim or Caddy won't be actually saying if the video games like Rugrats Studio Tour PS1 are actually bad games or even bad PlayStation games as a whole? Yes I did, so don't expect to see bad PS1 games - just get ready to see Studio Tour and Search for Reptar and even Rugrats in Paris PS1 - but not Rugrats in Paris trailer or Rugrats in Paris clips because that's not legal. There's actually a lot of Rugrats PS1 games that you probably don't know about, even if you do know all of the classic Rugrats music and Rugrats theme that appear in all of the PS1 games, more accurately the Rugrats Search for Reptar soundtrack or Search for Reptar OST. Caddy is looking at every PS1 game the Rugrats themselves starred in which is a surprising 6 titles, not just including Studio Tour PS1 and all the other Phil and Lil or Angelica video games mentioned earlier. There's also Nicktoons Racing PS1 from all of the classic Nicktoons in the 90s with 90s Nickelodeon and 90s Nicktoons, featuring Ren and Stimpy, The Wild Thornberries and even AAH Real Monsters which I never saw. On top of Nicktoons Racing game and not the new Nicktoons kart racer on PS5 and Switch called Nickelodeon Kart Racers review and Nickelodeon Kart Racers gameplay, there's also Rocket Power PS1 from the Rocket Power Nickelodeon show featuring the Rocket Power intro, much like the classic Rugrats intro from the original Rugrats opening and not the Rugrats reboot intro - not the Rugrats new series with Dil Pickles who was in the Rugrats the Movie and Rugrats the Movie trailer, but the new Rugrats Paramount Plus that nobody likes. VCT Americas Stage 1 marks the next step in the race to Champions Shanghai, and the stakes could not be higher. Twelve teams, two groups, and only three spots on the line.

Group Alpha is fueled by one central clash. Brazil versus the Americas. LOUD, MIBR led by Aspas, and FURIA bring regional pride, while Leviatán and Cloud9 look to challenge them. G2 stands in the middle, ready to prove they still belong among the elite.Group Omega is shaped by pressure. NRG stand as the favorites, but KRÜ arrive ready to fight, and Envy reenters the spotlight with legendary names looking to prove they can still compete.

Only 3 teams will reach Masters London. Tune in to find out Americas representatives!

We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, and Verizon.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

In 2026, the LCS Fantasy app becomes a comprehensive hub for fans. Schedules, standings, content, and fantasy integration all live in one place, making it easier than ever to follow the league and compete with your friends.
